description: This Java class defines a REST controller for authentication endpoints, including login and registration, using Spring Boot framework. It leverages external services for handling auth logic and uses annotations for API documentation and request mapping.

classes.name: AuthController
classes.description: REST controller providing endpoints for user authentication including login and registration.

methods.name: login
methods.description: Handles user login by validating request and returning a JWT token upon successful authentication.

methods.name: register
methods.description: Handles new user registration, creates the user, and returns a JWT token upon success.
